verdict.rationale: Docs describe syncing modeled data to 300+ destinations with per-sync field mapping ('A sync connects one model to one destination object... and describes how the model's rows map into that destination') and audience/segment filtering via Customer Studio, plus CDC-based change filtering. Community corroborates declarative field mapping and breadth of integrations (70+/300+ destinations) as a differentiator vs competitors. missing for 10: a public catalog/list of the specific 300+ destinations with docs per integration, and independent verification of filtering granularity beyond vendor claims.
